test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the third number is related to the fourth number.

1246 : 2164 :: 3482 : 4328 :: ? : 2548
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

** First and second digits are interchanged & third and fourth digits are interchanged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72bf8f1e73bebae0601a50029ddacc88015cf764805ee77b241626875cde3809.png] 1246 becomes 2164

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/665a5d2dda4325c9b4acb9b032e49affb91634f0306469c31439040e601510f2.png] 3482 becomes 4328

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb4e08adea77e439ce17579fa93ee2bde24523d40babe6d0219b83fbd0e3f91d.png] 2548 is obtained from 5284

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 2.**
